mintAuthority.summary: Canonical Ethereum USDx has two live MARKET_ROLE holders: USDxMarket and the 3-of-5 governance Safe. The Safe can call token mint directly without market capacity or collateral checks, as well as administer roles, routes and capacity. Proxy upgrades separately require a two-day timelock whose proposer and executor are the same Safe. Offchain reconciliation and key independence remain unverified.

controls.label: Axis USDxMarket canonical issuer
controls.capDescription: Deployment-to-26114911 configuration census and pinned getters identify four enabled USDC/USDT mint/redeem routes and channels, no CapSet events, and 20m minted / 1m redeemed USDx block limits. These Safe-admin mutable market-only limits do not constrain direct Safe token minting.

sources.label: USDxMarket signed-order settlement and capacity checks

controls.evidence: At block 26107703, USDx.hasRole(MARKET_ROLE, USDxMarket) returned true. Official documentation identifies the market as the live launch issuance route and documents cap-limited atomic settlement of user-signed orders. The market does not independently value collateral through an external price oracle. Future BRIDGE_ROLE assignment is an admin expansion surface, not an authored active bridge deployment.

controls.label: Axis published mint operator
controls.capDescription: Executes signed mint orders through account, signature/delegation, nonce, route/channel and capacity checks; the pinned market block-mint maximum is 20m USDx. Governance can change limits and separately mint directly.
controls.evidence: USDxMarket.hasRole(MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE, this published wallet) returned true at block 26107703. Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history from deployment through block 26110188 identifies this as the sole current mint operator, corroborated by hasRole. Docs call it KMS-secured; no independent HSM/MPC key-custody attestation was retrieved. It executes signed settlement, while the governance Safe separately retains direct token mint authority.

controls.evidence: Block 26110188 complete role history and hasRole identify the Safe as token admin and direct uncapped minter. Follow-up block 26114911 reproduces the same 3-of-5 owners, complete empty module list and zero guard. Slot zero identifies runtime-matched Safe 1.4.1 implementation 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a; the handler is runtime-matched standard CompatibilityFallbackHandler 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99. Signature methods require Safe validation, receiver methods do not mint, and simulation uses simulateAndRevert with full rollback. FallbackManager CALLs rather than delegates to the handler, appending the original caller. No persistent issuance bypass was identified. Signed arbitrary CALL/DELEGATECALL and self-authorized permission/module/handler changes remain unbounded governance reach; signer independence remains unverified.

review.evidence: Complete deployment-to-26110188 role census establishes Safe administration, market plus Safe token minters, the sole published mint operator, no bridge-role grants, and Safe-governed 172800-second proxy upgrades. At 26114911 the market and Safe implementation/handler runtimes match verified source. Deployment-to-26114911 MarketConfig census (183 logs) and pinned getters close four USDC/USDT mint/redeem routes and channels, no CapSet events, and 20m/1m USDx mint/redeem block maxima. Market settle/mint/redeem share signed account/nonce/route validation, capacity consumption and atomic ERC20 movement plus USDx mint/burn; settlementData is hashed, not executed. Configured token/destination addresses introduce no generic calldata execution. Safe fallback methods add no persistent unquorummed issuance bypass; signed arbitrary execution and self-authorized control mutation remain unbounded adverse reach. Incident review covers the exact canonical V2 deployment on July 23, 2026 through block 26122473 (October 5, 2026 00:06:59 UTC; hash 0x2ad181b79dfa7dc5f5c23f6130815c66322c76d9f84c269439a676395aef492c). Eleven contiguous unfiltered 50000-block-or-smaller ranges beginning with Safe creation at 25597751 returned all 16849 token, market, config, Safe, timelock and vault logs. The 94 token mint events comprise 59 market mints and 35 direct Safe mints in 29 successful transactions; the two delegated relayer transactions trace through ordinary Safe execTransaction and signature recovery, not a module bypass. Each proxy has only its deployment Upgraded event; the timelock has no scheduled or executed calls. Current implementation, Safe mastercopy and handler code match the prior reviewed runtimes; role membership, 3-of-5 owners, empty modules, zero guard and two-day delay are rechecked at the same pin. Issuer security/audit disclosures, the complete documentation index, announcements index and governance disclosure were reviewed on October 5; no relevant incident or postmortem was identified. Governance documents no public proposal/voting process. All 1293 DeFiLlama hack records were searched for Axis, Coordinate and USDx with no name matches; scoped public incident searches likewise found no attributable report. Remediated audit findings are not treated as deployed incidents, and unrelated Axis entities or other USDX tokens are excluded. This establishes no known relevant incident within the reviewed public and onchain scope, not absence of undisclosed offchain loss or proof of reserve reconciliation. Offchain reconciliation, supervision and independent signer/operator custody remain separately unresolved; no protective cap or independence credit is inferred.
